features.description: Close-time enforcement + disposition. Extend completion_auditor to emit consumer_outcome_unproven and apply the enforcement posture: a pure posture function returns block|advisory by goal_type. At plan close, product-class plans (goal_type in {parity, new_feature, migration, incident}, the objective-contract-required set) with declared consumer journeys BLOCK unless each declared consumer outcome is satisfied (F002), explicitly deferred via a structured non-goal, or operator-dispositioned via a structured record; internal substrate plans (goal_type in {mechanical, infra, refactor}) are advisory unless opted in. consumer=both requires BOTH families proven (D013). Typed-skip and seeded evidence do not count as consumer-surface captures. The >=1-real requirement is about JOURNEY EXECUTION provenance, not data-source availability (D015). The actual close BLOCK is a DETERMINISTIC pre-flip gate in completion_gate.close_plan (consumer_outcome_gate), NOT the LLM F0 cluster triage (whose only blocking triage is child_plan): completion_auditor's consumer_outcome_unproven finding is the advisory/observability surface, while the deterministic gate independently blocks the active->completed flip (D021). The gate ACTIVATES when ANY of (D022): (a) plan.md frontmatter experience_readiness_opt_in: true; (b) the objective_contract declares any user_journey with a consumer set; OR (c) goal_type is product-class {parity, new_feature, migration, incident} OR plan metadata marks product/migration/readiness/ux/consumer-facing delivery. opt_in is NOT the only activation path — a product claim cannot dodge the gate by omitting the frontmatter field. When active: an unproven consumer outcome on a product-class OR consumer-journey-bearing plan BLOCKS; a substrate plan activated solely via opt_in with no consumer journeys is advisory (warn); a plan with NONE of the triggers (substrate-only, no consumer journeys) is a gate no-op.
features.acceptance: experience_readiness_active(goal_type, opted_in, has_consumer_journey, product_metadata) is pure and returns True when opted_in OR has_consumer_journey OR goal_type in {parity, new_feature, migration, incident} OR product_metadata marks product/migration/readiness/ux/consumer-facing; enforcement_posture(...) then returns block when active AND (product-class goal_type/metadata OR has_consumer_journey), advisory when active solely via opt_in on a substrate plan with no consumer journeys, and noop when not active (opt_in is not the only activation path). completion_auditor emits consumer_outcome_unproven (added to the gap_class taxonomy with a severity rank) when a contract journey's declared consumer is not proven: for consumer=human or =agent the named family must have a satisfying consumer-surface capture per F002/F004; for consumer=both BOTH families must (a missing family -> consumer_outcome_unproven). substrate-only, seeded-only on a non-fixture_only journey, or typed-skip-only all fail to satisfy. REAL-vs-DEGRADED reconciliation (D015): the required >=1 real (non-seeded) end-to-end journey per objective claim per declared consumer is about the journey EXECUTION running on the real surface (data_provenance != seeded); a required_data_source honestly degraded (availability=unavailable, F004) WITHIN such a real journey still satisfies — only a journey that is entirely seeded / substrate-only / typed-skip-only fails. Deferral is STRUCTURED: an objective_contract non_goal entry that names {journey, consumer}; operator disposition is a STRUCTURED consumer_outcome_dispositions[] record {journey, consumer, reason, dispositioned_by, at} — prose alone never satisfies (D016). At close on a product-class plan, an unsatisfied + non-deferred + non-dispositioned consumer outcome BLOCKS via a DETERMINISTIC pre-flip gate consumer_outcome_gate(contract, evidence, goal_type, opted_in, dispositions) that completion_gate.close_plan invokes BEFORE the status flip and INDEPENDENTLY of the codex F0 cluster triage (D021); the same on a substrate plan warns. opted_in is sourced from plan.md frontmatter experience_readiness_opt_in (D022). Tests: (1) product-class human journey with only API-test evidence -> consumer_outcome_unproven AND close blocked; (2) same with a real screenshot capture -> no finding, close not blocked; (3) seeded-only screenshot on a non-fixture_only journey -> blocked; (4) structured operator disposition recorded -> close allowed; (5) a substrate plan (mechanical/infra/refactor) with NO consumer journeys + not opted-in -> gate no-op (close not blocked); (6) a journey 'covered' only by typed-skips -> consumer_outcome_unproven; (7) consumer=both with only a human capture -> consumer_outcome_unproven (agent family unproven); (8) a real journey whose required_data_source is honestly degraded -> satisfied, close not blocked; (9) the deterministic consumer_outcome_gate blocks the active->completed flip even when the codex audit envelope is agree/empty (block is gate-driven, not triage-driven); (10) a substrate plan with frontmatter experience_readiness_opt_in=true + an unproven consumer journey blocks, (11) NO-DODGE: a product-class plan with an unproven consumer journey but WITHOUT the opt_in frontmatter still activates and BLOCKS; (12) ANY consumer-journey-bearing plan (incl. substrate) blocks an unproven outcome regardless of the opt_in flag (trigger (b)); the ADVISORY/warn path is ONLY a substrate plan that opted in but declares NO consumer journeys (opted-in for visibility) — resolving the round-3 contradiction (D030); (13) NO-JOURNEY: a product-class plan that declares NO consumer journey emits no_consumer_journey_declared (advisory finding) rather than silently passing the gate (D031). MERGED-API ALIGNMENT (D032/D033/D034 — added at 2b lock-prep against merged 2a-core 1b90198 + 2a-F004 f4ef2b9). PREREQUISITE (D032): 2b lock/build REQUIRES 2a-core (2026-06-15-001) AND 2a-F004 (2026-06-15-002) MERGED to main — SATISFIED (2a-core 1b90198, 2a-F004 f4ef2b9); consumer_outcome_gate imports the merged checkers/enums and does NOT redefine them. CONCRETE API SURFACE (D033): the per-family consumer-surface capture is read from 2a-core's experience_readiness_typing.check_journey(consumer, requirements, refs) -> (results, JourneyVerdict{satisfied|agent_satisfied_human_pending|unsatisfied}); the real-vs-degraded honesty reconciliation is read from 2a-F004's experience_readiness_honesty.check_degraded_honesty(required_sources, allowed_degraded_modes, refs) -> HonestyResult{verdict: honest|degraded_dishonest|human_not_yet_typed_pending, satisfied: bool} (and check_objectives(...) for objective-keyed grouping). The 'real journey-EXECUTION' notion (formerly referenced loosely as 'F005') IS 2a-F004's HonestyResult.satisfied over EXECUTION_CLASSES (2a-F004 D005/D011) — NOT a separate F005 feature. TRI-STATE RULE (D034): consumer_outcome_gate maps the merged tri-states deterministically: (unsatisfied OR degraded_dishonest) -> BLOCK on a product-class plan; (satisfied AND honest) -> PASS; (agent_satisfied_human_pending OR human_not_yet_typed_pending) -> DEFERRED/ADVISORY, recorded as a STRUCTURED pending consumer outcome (consumer_outcome_pending), NEITHER a pass NOR a block. Rationale: this honors 2a-core D060 scope ('shared vocabulary now, agent enforcement now, human producer typing later') — a pending human family must not hard-block consumer=both product plans that no human-surface producer can yet satisfy. Once a human-producer-typing plan lands, the pending state MAY be promoted to BLOCK for product-class plans (future increment, not this plan). Tests: (14) consumer=both with agent proven + human family not_yet_typed -> consumer_outcome_pending, close NOT blocked (deferred, not pass); (15) degraded_dishonest honesty verdict -> BLOCK; (16) the pending outcome is recorded as a structured record, not silently dropped. ROUND-1 RECONCILIATION (D035-D039). UNPROVEN-vs-PENDING BOUNDARY (D035, resolves the critical): consumer_outcome_unproven (BLOCKING unless structurally deferred or dispositioned) applies when a REQUIRED family is TYPED-but-unsatisfied (wrong evidence_class / seeded-only / typed-skip-only / substrate-only) OR when the ENFORCED AGENT family is missing/unproven; a required HUMAN family that is not_yet_typed (2a-core D060 — NO structured evidence at all) yields consumer_outcome_pending (advisory, the platform-level human-typing deferral) and is NOT consumer_outcome_unproven and does NOT require an explicit non_goal entry. So for consumer=both: agent missing/unproven -> unproven->BLOCK; human not_yet_typed -> pending->ADVISORY (close not blocked); human OR agent TYPED-but-unsatisfied -> unproven->BLOCK. This makes test (7) precise (consumer=both with only a human capture blocks because the AGENT family is unproven, agent being enforced) and is the symmetric complement of test (14). GATE SIGNATURE (D036): consumer_outcome_gate(contract, evidence, goal_type, opted_in, dispositions, product_metadata) — product_metadata is included because it is one of the activation paths (D022 trigger (c)) AND a posture input; enforcement_posture/experience_readiness_active receive it too. NO_CONSUMER_JOURNEY TAXONOMY (D039): no_consumer_journey_declared is registered in the gap_class taxonomy with an ADVISORY severity rank (below consumer_outcome_unproven), output shape parallel to consumer_outcome_unproven {finding_id, gap_class, severity, journey:null, consumer:null, note}; it is advisory (warn) and never blocks. Tests added: (17) structured non_goal deferral naming {journey,consumer} -> close ALLOWED; (18) prose-only deferral (no structured non_goal entry / no disposition record) -> still BLOCKS (D016 prose-never-satisfies); (19) substrate plan opted_in=true with NO declared consumer journeys -> ADVISORY/warn (not block, not silent pass) (D030); (20) no_consumer_journey_declared emitted with the advisory taxonomy shape and does not block.
